description: Fetch the world-record / top-N leaderboard for a specific game category. Returns ranked runs with finish times (ISO-8601 duration plus seconds), run date, players, and weblink. Get game_id from search_games and category_id from get_categories. Example: get_leaderboard({ game_id: "o1y9wo6q", category_id: "7kjpp4k3", top: 10 })

_apiKey.description: Optional speedrun.com API key for authenticated access; omit to use the shared platform key

category_id.description: Speedrun.com category ID, as returned by get_categories

game_id.description: Speedrun.com game ID, as returned by search_games

top.description: Number of top-ranked runs to return (default 10)

name: get_leaderboard
title: Get Leaderboard
